context_notes: Phase 5 Wave 1 complete. JarvisMCP package created (renamed from MCP due to SDK library-name collision — same JarvisLogging precedent). 16 SPM tests on JarvisMCP, 4 commits 896d7fb..fb0a0e7. ChildSpawnGate is the single Process() spawn surface (verified by grep gate); per-server restart mutex shares one restart across concurrent callers; 100-cycle FD-leak test delta=0 from baseline=4. Closes MCP-01 + MCP-07 + MCP-08. Three load-bearing executor deviations: (1) renamed MCP→JarvisMCP throughout (downstream plans must import JarvisMCP); (2) PID-pinned process.terminationHandler to prevent stale handlers flipping isCrashed=true on live restarted process; (3) FD_CLOEXEC retrofit on parent-side Pipe ends after Process.run() because Foundation creates Pipe FDs without O_CLOEXEC. 297 total SPM tests across 9 packages. STATE/ROADMAP byte-identical. Tree clean on develop at fb0a0e7. Xcode 26 xctest harness still upstream-blocked.
